entries.answer_en: The Sports Facilities page lists Sports Activities Building G1 for male users and Building B1 for female users. entries.answer_en: UAEU Library Research Data Services explicitly offers Data Visualization and Data Cleaning assistance. The same page lists data-management planning and open-science guidance, data coaching and statistical consultations, digital publishing, and data-hosting/repository guidance. The published contact is rds@uaeu.ac.ae; the inquiry form requests details of the research/data assistance needed. It does not establish that an inquiry has been submitted through this chat.

entries.answer_en: The UAEU homepage UAEU at a Glance cards inspected on 5 November 2026 display QS Global Rankings #217, THE Global Rankings 235, and QS Arab Region Rankings #5. These are figures displayed in those homepage cards, which do not identify a ranking edition/year; the inspection date is not a ranking edition. Preserve the named ranking body and global versus Arab-region scope.
